  - Location 2 is joisted masonry built 1961 in an earthquake zone [locations[2].zip, locations[2].construction, locations[2].year_built].

- Loc 2, San Jose: joisted masonry, 1961, sprinklered, no alarm [locations[2].construction, locations[2].year_built, locations[2].sprinklered, locations[2].alarm_type].
- Loc 3, Seattle: fire resistive, 2010, sprinklered [locations[3].construction, locations[3].year_built, locations[3].sprinklered].
- Loc 4, Omaha: non-combustible, 2004, sprinklered [locations[4].construction, locations[4].year_built, locations[4].sprinklered].

**Loss history**
One closed lightning claim, 2024 policy year, incurred $52,800 [claims[25G855947].cause, claims[25G855947].status, claims[25G855947].incurred]. Five-year incurred is $52,800 against five-year premium of $230,450 [totals.five_year_incurred, totals.five_year_premium]. The loss ratio is 22.9%. No other claims appear in 2021–2025 [loss_years[2021].claim_count, loss_years[2022].claim_count, loss_years[2023].claim_count, loss_years[2025].claim_count].
